# Global News

> Breaking Canadian and international news, video, and live coverage across politics, business, health, entertainment, sports, and local markets.

Global News is a Canadian news publisher covering national, world, and local stories with article pages, video, live streams, newsletters, and topic hubs. The site organizes reporting by major editorial verticals and by city or region, with dedicated local news pages for major Canadian markets.

## Core News Sections
- [Home](https://globalnews.ca/): Main entry point for breaking news, latest headlines, video, and featured coverage.
- [Canada](https://globalnews.ca/canada/): National Canadian news, public affairs, crime, weather, and major developing stories.
- [World](https://globalnews.ca/world/): International news coverage, geopolitics, conflicts, disasters, and global developments.
- [Politics](https://globalnews.ca/politics/): Federal and provincial politics, elections, policy, Parliament, and political analysis.
- [Money](https://globalnews.ca/money/): Business, personal finance, housing, inflation, markets, and economic news.
- [Health](https://globalnews.ca/health/): Public health, medicine, wellness, disease outbreaks, and healthcare system reporting.
- [Entertainment](https://globalnews.ca/entertainment/): Celebrity, film, television, music, streaming, and culture news.
- [Sports](https://globalnews.ca/sports/): Canadian and international sports news, leagues, events, and athlete coverage.

## News Formats
- [Video](https://globalnews.ca/videos/): Video hub for clips, interviews, explainers, and breaking news segments.
- [Live National Stream](https://globalnews.ca/live/national/): Live national news stream with rolling coverage and scheduled programming.
- [Trending](https://globalnews.ca/tag/trending/): Popular and widely read stories gaining attention across the site.
- [Weather](https://globalnews.ca/tag/weather/): Weather-related reporting, forecasts, storms, and climate-driven news coverage.
- [Crime](https://globalnews.ca/tag/crime/): Crime reporting, police investigations, courts, and public safety stories.
- [Opinion](https://globalnews.ca/tag/opinion/): Commentary and analysis pieces on current events and public issues.

## Local News Markets
- [Toronto](https://globalnews.ca/toronto/): Toronto local news, GTA coverage, transit, crime, politics, and community updates.
- [Montreal](https://globalnews.ca/montreal/): Montreal and Quebec local reporting, politics, weather, and regional developments.
- [BC](https://globalnews.ca/bc/): British Columbia news including Vancouver-area coverage, politics, and breaking stories.
- [Calgary](https://globalnews.ca/calgary/): Calgary local news, Alberta issues, weather, crime, and city reporting.
- [Edmonton](https://globalnews.ca/edmonton/): Edmonton local coverage including municipal news, crime, and provincial developments.
- [Winnipeg](https://globalnews.ca/winnipeg/): Winnipeg and Manitoba news, weather, politics, and local community stories.
- [Halifax](https://globalnews.ca/halifax/): Halifax and Atlantic Canada news, weather, and regional reporting.
- [Regina](https://globalnews.ca/regina/): Regina and Saskatchewan local news, politics, and community coverage.

## Additional Local Markets
- [Saskatoon](https://globalnews.ca/saskatoon/): Saskatoon local reporting on city issues, crime, weather, and events.
- [Kingston](https://globalnews.ca/kingston/): Kingston-area news, municipal updates, education, and local developments.
- [Peterborough](https://globalnews.ca/peterborough/): Peterborough local news, weather, crime, and community reporting.
- [Okanagan](https://globalnews.ca/okanagan/): Okanagan regional coverage including Kelowna-area news and events.
- [Lethbridge](https://globalnews.ca/lethbridge/): Lethbridge local stories, southern Alberta issues, and community updates.
- [National](https://globalnews.ca/national/): National broadcast and network-level news programming hub.
- [Durham](https://globalnews.ca/durham/): Durham Region local coverage, municipal issues, and community news.
- [Barrie](https://globalnews.ca/barrie/): Barrie and Simcoe County local reporting and breaking news.

## Topic Hubs
- [Coronavirus](https://globalnews.ca/tag/coronavirus/): COVID-19 news, public health updates, and pandemic-related reporting.
- [Housing](https://globalnews.ca/tag/housing/): Housing affordability, real estate, mortgages, and rental market coverage.
- [Inflation](https://globalnews.ca/tag/inflation/): Inflation reporting, consumer prices, interest rates, and cost-of-living news.
- [Climate Change](https://globalnews.ca/tag/climate-change/): Climate policy, extreme weather, emissions, and environmental reporting.
- [Immigration](https://globalnews.ca/tag/immigration/): Immigration policy, newcomers, visas, and border-related coverage.
- [Education](https://globalnews.ca/tag/education/): Schools, universities, curriculum, labour issues, and student news.
- [Indigenous](https://globalnews.ca/tag/indigenous/): Indigenous communities, rights, reconciliation, and related reporting.
- [Israel-Hamas Conflict](https://globalnews.ca/tag/israel-hamas-conflict/): Ongoing conflict coverage, diplomacy, and humanitarian developments.

## Consumer and Lifestyle Coverage
- [Lifestyle](https://globalnews.ca/lifestyle/): Lifestyle reporting on family, relationships, food, travel, and trends.
- [Food](https://globalnews.ca/tag/food/): Food news, recalls, restaurant trends, and consumer-interest stories.
- [Travel](https://globalnews.ca/tag/travel/): Travel advisories, tourism, airlines, and destination-related reporting.
- [Parenting](https://globalnews.ca/tag/parenting/): Parenting advice, family issues, and child-focused news coverage.
- [Shopping Essentials](https://globalnews.ca/tag/shopping-essentials/): Product roundups, buying guides, and commerce-oriented recommendations.
- [Pets](https://globalnews.ca/tag/pets/): Pet care, animal stories, and veterinary or consumer pet news.

## Entertainment and Culture Topics
- [Royal Family](https://globalnews.ca/tag/royal-family/): News and features related to the British royal family.
- [Music](https://globalnews.ca/tag/music/): Music industry news, artists, tours, and album-related coverage.
- [Movies](https://globalnews.ca/tag/movies/): Film news, releases, box office, and entertainment reporting.
- [TV](https://globalnews.ca/tag/tv/): Television news, series coverage, streaming, and broadcast developments.
- [Celebrities](https://globalnews.ca/tag/celebrities/): Celebrity news, interviews, legal issues, and public appearances.
- [Books](https://globalnews.ca/tag/books/): Book news, authors, publishing stories, and literary coverage.

## Sports Topics
- [NHL](https://globalnews.ca/tag/nhl/): National Hockey League news, teams, players, and major developments.
- [NFL](https://globalnews.ca/tag/nfl/): National Football League coverage, games, players, and league news.
- [NBA](https://globalnews.ca/tag/nba/): Basketball coverage focused on NBA teams, players, and events.
- [MLB](https://globalnews.ca/tag/mlb/): Major League Baseball news, scores context, and player developments.
- [Olympics](https://globalnews.ca/tag/olympics/): Olympic sports coverage, athletes, and international competition news.
- [Soccer](https://globalnews.ca/tag/soccer/): Soccer reporting spanning domestic leagues, international play, and tournaments.

## Service and Engagement Pages
- [Newsletters](https://globalnews.ca/pages/newsletters/): Email newsletter signup page for curated news and updates.
- [Alerts](https://globalnews.ca/pages/global-news-app/): Mobile app information for alerts, live news, and on-the-go access.
- [Contact Us](https://globalnews.ca/pages/contact-us/): Contact information for news tips, feedback, and general inquiries.
- [About Global News](https://globalnews.ca/pages/about-global-news/): Background on the newsroom, programming, and editorial organization.
- [Advertise](https://globalnews.ca/pages/advertise/): Advertising and partnership information for brands and agencies.
- [Careers](https://globalnews.ca/pages/careers/): Employment opportunities across editorial, production, and corporate teams.
